local_store.rationale: Outside the git tree so it cannot be committed, stashed or diffed by accident. The repos are public.

hard_rules: Never write a secret value into the repo, docs, logs or Issue #2 - all are public
Never print, echo, commit or expose a token value; never ask for one to be pasted into chat
Never read back a Cloudflare Worker secret through a metadata-only API
Never touch the unrelated Hyperdrive config talento-cpv-db
No merge to main, no production deploy, no further taxonomy APPLY/replay without explicit owner authorization
No mass approval of TERM->CPV relations
No ranking or weight changes to improve an isolated query
Every ranking or search correction must close with a fresh regression run against the frozen baseline
Do not guess ambiguous decisions - report them
